name: Perfume River walk
kicker: The dusk path between the two banks
summary: The river walk at the centre of Hue: a path from Truong Tien Bridge to Nghinh Lương Đình, the old royal landing, with Kỳ Đài, the 1807 flag tower, across the water on the north bank. Walk it at dusk, at the end of a citadel or tomb day. Paths run on both banks, and the path is kept for walkers.
getThere: On foot from Truong Tien Bridge.
heroCaption: Truong Tien Bridge through the trees on the Perfume River

notice.title: A footpath, and a flood risk
notice.body: The parks centre treats the path as a walk and has asked Phú Xuân ward police to keep electric bikes off it. In a flood week the path may be unusable, so check the river that morning.

body: Start at Truong Tien Bridge and walk to Nghinh Lương Đình, with paths on both banks. The south bank is the modern city. The north bank is the old imperial city behind its walls.

Kỳ Đài, the flag tower built in 1807 under Gia Long in three tiers, is the landmark on the north bank. Nghinh Lương Đình is the old royal landing, where the king stopped in summer and the royal boats tied up.
Make it the evening of a citadel or tomb day rather than a trip of its own. The night streets of phố Tây are close by when the walk is done.
